parameters.name: Comment
parameters.description: The description of the custom attribute. The value must be less than 256 characters in length.

parameters.name: DisplayEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to display the attribute on the details page. Default value: true.

parameters.name: DisplayName
parameters.description: The display name of the custom attribute. The value must be less than 128 characters in length.

parameters.name: EntityTypes
parameters.description:
The list of applicable entity types. Exact entity types and wildcard patterns such as `*-table` and `*-column` are supported. Examples:
- dataworks-project: workspace
- dataworks-dataset: DataWorks dataset
- maxcompute-table: MaxCompute table
- *-column: all column types

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: The custom attribute ID. The value must match `^custom-attribute:[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]{0,98}$`. The part after custom-attribute: must be less than 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: SearchFilterEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether the attribute can be used as a filter condition on the DataWorks Data Map search page. Default value: false. Currently, only the ENUM type supports setting this value to true.

parameters.name: Type
parameters.description: The type of the custom attribute. Valid values: ENUM, TEXT, and HYPERLINK.

parameters.name: ValueEnums
parameters.description: The enumeration values. This parameter is required when type is set to ENUM. This parameter is not supported for TEXT or HYPERLINK types.
